# Test fixtures

`ams.html`, `bzn.html`, `hnl.html` and `sea.html` are excerpts (headings and route tables only) of the
"Airlines and destinations" sections of the English Wikipedia articles for Amsterdam Airport Schiphol,
Bozeman Yellowstone International Airport, Daniel K. Inouye International Airport and
Seattle–Tacoma International Airport, retrieved 2026-11-13.

Wikipedia content is licensed under [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/);
authors are listed in each article's history on en.wikipedia.org.

They are frozen on purpose: tests assert exact values, so refresh them only together with the tests.
